patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — GoTo Connect and Slack share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose GoTo Connect only if your buying job matches “Remote-team UCaaS phone system with meetings and messaging — Phone System / CX / Contact C” rather than Slack's shape. Choose Slack only if your buying job matches “Channel-based team messaging platform — Free $0, Pro $7.25/user/month annual, Business+ $1” rather than GoTo Connect's shape. Workflow advantage: GoTo Connect leans business-phone, contact-center; Slack leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — GoTo Connect and Slack share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: GoTo Connect is Remote-team UCaaS phone system with meetings and messaging — Phone System / CX / Contact Center ladders are custom-quote (no public seat dol; Slack is Channel-based team messaging platform — Free $0, Pro $7.25/user/month annual, Business+ $15, Enterprise+ contact sales; huddles for light vi.
- Company-size focus: GoTo Connect (small-business, mid-market) vs Slack (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: GoTo Connect-leaning business-phone, contact-center vs Slack-leaning —.
- Researched limits: GoTo Connect — No published self-serve seat dollars — every plan is sales-quoted; Slack — Not a business phone system — no cloud phone, call routing, recording or power dialer.

Limitations — GoTo Connect: No published self-serve seat dollars — every plan is sales-quoted; Industry dollar ranges are low confidence and must not be treated as list prices; Slack: Not a business phone system — no cloud phone, call routing, recording or power dialer; No SMS or WhatsApp Business customer channels.

Poor-fit cases: GoTo Connect is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published self-serve seat dollars — every plan is sales-quoted · Slack is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a business phone system — no cloud phone, call routing, recording or power dialer · Avoid GoTo Connect if you actually need Slack's motion (Channel-based team messaging platform — Free $0, Pro $7.25/user/month annual, Bu)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
